stem: An analyst computes Voltmarkt's AOV as SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(*) on the sales table, which has one row per order line. How does the result compare with the true AOV?

options.text: Too low: an order with several lines is counted several times
Too high: an order with several lines is counted only once
The same: each order line is its own purchase, so it is right
Too low: guest orders with a missing customer are left out
